NC-2025-SB595.aiSummary: North Carolina enacted this law to change several tax and revenue rules. It changes parts of the state income tax code, withholding tax timing, and some tax credits, and it also updates rules on timber loss deductions and interest relief tied to past disaster tax bills. The law also shifts vapor directory enforcement to the Alcohol Law Enforcement Division, changes collection rules for tax foreclosure and special assessments, updates credit union and savings bank laws, gives retailers a way to round cash payments because the penny is being ended, and raises pay for members of the Piedmont Authority for Regional Transportation board.

NC-2025-HB565.aiSummary: The bill would limit the use of artificial intelligence in health insurance reviews and in health care billing. It would bar an AI-based tool from being the only reason to deny a review or prior authorization decision, and it would stop health care providers and AI developers from using AI for coding, billing, or records work if the system is made to push upcoding, which means billing for a higher level of care than was given. Beginning July 1, 2027, health care providers would also have to file yearly proof that they follow these rules to stay in Medicaid.
